name: x-post
description: Anti-bot-resilient publishing toolchain for X (Twitter) supporting text, images, videos, thread chains, quote tweets, Markdown X Articles, and multi-language video subtitle translation via real Chrome CDP.

capabilities.name: regular-posts
capabilities.description: Publish tweets with up to 4 images and sequential thread replies

capabilities.name: video-posts
capabilities.description: Upload MP4/MOV/WebM videos with automated transcode monitoring

capabilities.name: quote-tweets
capabilities.description: Quote existing public tweets with custom commentary

capabilities.name: x-articles
capabilities.description: Publish rich-text Markdown articles with cover images and embedded media

capabilities.name: video-translation
capabilities.description: Transcribe with Whisper, generate translation draft, burn subtitles with FFmpeg, and republish with attribution
